title: Salame Akhir
body:
Salaam E Akhir Pisar Ka Sunkar Hissain Maqtal Ko Ja Rahey-2
Kaha ho ay mere lal akbar.
Sada Ye Sarwar Laga Rahey Hai.
Salam.....
Negaho Me Cha Gaya Andhera.
Nazar nahi Aa Raha hai Rasta-2.
Kabhi Hai Girtey kabhi smbhaltey.
Magar Kabhi Ladkhada Rahey hai.
Salam.....
Ay Lal Deykho Zami Ke Uppar.
Main Girraha Hu Kadam Kadam Par-2
Nahi Hai Koi Jo Dey Sahara.
Pisar Ko Apney Bula Rahe Hai.
Salam....
Jo Lashey Akbar Pe Pahuchy Sarwar.
Toh Deykhtey Hai Ajeg Manzar-2.
Badan Hai Akbar Ka Khoon Me Tar.
Wo Putleon Ko Hela Rahey Hai.
Salam......
Ye Sehne Pucha Ay Merey Dilbar.
Rakhe Ho Seney Pe Hath Qeunkar.2
Hata ke siney Se Hath Akbar.
Kaleyja Apna deikha raha hai
Salam......
Jo Sehne Zakhme Kaleyja Deykha.
Toh Baiythey do Zahnuo pe maula.2
Chadhake apni phir asti ko.
Wo tuta nayza hila rahey hai.
Salam.....
Jo ya ali kehke phal ko khaycha.
Toh sath bahar kaleyja aya-2
Zaifi me dag e nuwjawa ka.
Hussaim dil par utha rahey hai.
Salam....
Jawan beta ragad ke aydi.
Jo mar gaya samne tadap kar.2
Hussain lashe jawan pisar par.
Lahu ke ansu baha rahey hai.
Salam...
Zara yeh deykho toh seh gurbat.
Ay momino akey karbala main-2
Hussain kadiyal jawan betey.
Ka lasha tanha utha rahey hai.
Salam.....
Na uth saka jab jawa ka lasha.
Toh rakhdiya Khake Karbala Par.2
Phir nanhe baccho ko sahe wala.
Madad ke khatir bula rahey hai.
Salaam....
Hussain maqtal se nujawa ka.
Jo lasha kehme Me Laekey aye.2
Harek Bibi tadap rahi hai.
Hussain noha suna rahey hai
Salam...
Utha ke hatho ko apne maula.
Khuda se roro dua hai karte-2
Qubul karley ye hadiya malik.
Ham apna wada nibha rahey hai.
Salam....
Kiya jo tehrir ye maine noha.
Hai isme taeidey mula shamil.2
Hai khush nasibi Teyri Mohamd.
Key maula nuha likha rahey hai.
Salam.....
